title: Doozy Vape Co Infinity Pineapple Raspberry 50/50 Shortfill E-Liquid 100ml
description: Pineapple Raspberry by Doozy Infinity is a bright, juicy fruit combo that balances sweet and tangy notes with delightful results. The Pineapple comes through with its sharp and tangy, golden sweetness, while Raspberry adds a ruby red jammy depth that’s both vibrant and slightly tart. Together, they create a refreshing all-day vape that delivers deep flavour and reliable satisfaction. This balanced 50VG/50PG e-liquid is perfect for mouth-to-lung (MTL) vaping in pod systems, pens and starter devices. Supplied in a 120ml bottle with 100ml of nicotine-free e-liquid, there’s space to add two 10ml nic shots for your preferred strength. Part of the Doozy Infinity Podfill range, this e-liquid is ideal for vapers who want bold flavour in a longer-lasting MTL format.
